items.max_tt_source: User-confirmed in-game item maximum TT; numeric decay was not verified.
items.note: User confirms maximum TT 6.40 PED. JoinEntropia publishes 0.99 PEC decay, 64 Mind Essence and 1.630 PEC total; with 0.0001 PED/ME the arithmetic is 0.0163 PED/use. This corroborating publication may share community data and is not measured proof. Nexus still quotes conflicting Decay 17 and MaxTT 11. Automatic cost remains unknown/unpriced; do not enable it solely from these publications. No live cast/decay test is required or authorized.

items.name: Vivo S10
items.note: Cost 0.0133 PED/use = Nexus decay 1.33 PEC, no ammo (Entropia Nexus API and item page). Entropia Central lists 1.35 PEC (0.0135 PED); the catalog keeps the Nexus figure as the structured source the rest of this catalog uses. Charged once per use: each use prints one direct-heal line; 'Received Effect Over Time: Heal' appears only when the effect starts, and smaller tick lines are never charged. HoT share 20% is derived from the user's chat log (direct receipts 11.6-15.2 = 80% of 14.3-19.0; ticks <= 1.9 every ~2 s), not published. Capped, diminished or ambiguous receipts stay unpriced and are counted as such.

behavior.evidence: Duration: Nexus description 'Part of the healing done with this tool is gained over a 10 second period' (EffectsOnUse/EffectsOnEquip empty). Fraction and tick interval: user chat log 2026-11-17, run ph-99668ce85773: direct receipts 11.6-15.2 every ~2 s with no new marker per cast, ticks 0.1-1.9 every ~2 s for ~10 s after the last cast.
